meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把项目从起步到现在的开发历程整理成一篇叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想回顾项目从零到现在的完整开发历程并写成一份报告
copy.tagline_en: Turn a project's development history into a narrative report
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to retell a project's full development journey as a report

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取 claude-mem 里该项目的完整时间线记录,写出名为「Journey Into [项目名]」的叙事报告,覆盖项目起源、架构演进、关键突破等板块,并存成 markdown 文件。
howto.when: 当你说要写时间线报告、项目历史分析或完整项目报告时触发。前提是 claude-mem worker 正在运行,且该项目已有记录。

say.text: 给 tokyo 项目写一份 journey 报告
say.note: 会拉取该项目时间线并生成报告文件

say.text: 分析我这个项目的完整开发历史
say.note: 以当前目录名作为项目名
按你指定的路径保存 markdown

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads the project's full timeline from claude-mem and writes a narrative report titled "Journey Into [Project]" covering genesis, architecture, breakthroughs and more, saving it as a markdown file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for a timeline report, project history analysis, or full project report. Requires the claude-mem worker running with recorded observations for that project.

say_en.text: Write a journey report for the tokyo project
say_en.note: Fetches the timeline and generates the report file

say_en.text: Analyze my project's full development history
say_en.note: Uses the current directory as the project name

say_en.text: Write the full project report to ./report.md
say_en.note: Saves markdown to the path you give
